points.description: Identifies the feature-extraction part of a CNN: a convolutional layer with kernels/filters convolving over the input image, followed by an activation layer (e.g. ReLU) and a pooling layer (max or average). Equivalent wording accepted; mentioning at least the convolutional layer and one of activation/pooling is not enough for full marks — all three are expected.
points.partial_credit: Half if only two of convolution, activation, pooling are named/described correctly.

points.description: Identifies the classification part: one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax (output) layer.
